### ⚠️ Requires [Eggolib](https://eggolib.github.io/latest/) to be installed! ⚠️

## Has Spawn Point

---


[__Entity Condition Type__](https://eggolib.github.io/latest/types/entity_condition_types/has_spawn_point)

Checks if the entity has a spawnpoint.

Type ID: `eggolib:has_spawn_point`




---

### 📝 Note

This entity condition type will only work for players.



---

### Examples

=== "Example #1"

    ```json
    "condition": {
        "type": "eggolib:has_spawn_point"
    }
    ```



[1]: ../entity_condition_types.md
